newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA POLICE ARREST 24,000 OVER JO'BURG WINTER.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA POLICE ARREST 24,000 OVER JO'BURG WINTER.

text.p: South African police said on Tuesday they had arrested 24,040 people for a host of offences and seized 734 cars either stolen or hijacked worth 22 million rand ($4.68 million) in Johannesburg alone since April.
Most of arrests in the crime prevention operations carried out in the country's commercial heartland were of illegal immigrants, who numbered 12,063, but 248 murder suspects were also nabbed.
A total of 140 car-jackers, 803 robbers and 719 burglars were arrested as well. Police said in their statement they had also seized 872 illegal firearms and 5,690 rounds of ammunition.

President Nelson Mandela's government has been hard-pressed to deal with a violent crime wave since it won power in historic all-race elections in 1994. Police figures show 5,863 murders were reported country-wide from January to March this year.
